name: flare-core-rn-app
description: Production-oriented IM app template for flare-core-typescript-sdk (React Native).

scripts.ios: npm run sync:dev-token-secret && node scripts/run-native.js ios
scripts.android: npm run sync:dev-token-secret && node scripts/run-native.js android
scripts.bundle:ios: npm run sync:dev-token-secret && rm -rf /tmp/flare-core-rn-app-bundle && mkdir -p /tmp/flare-core-rn-app-bundle && react-native bundle --platform ios --entry-file index.js --bundle-output /tmp/flare-core-rn-app-bundle/main.jsbundle --assets-dest /tmp/flare-core-rn-app-bundle/assets --dev true --reset-cache
scripts.bundle:android: npm run sync:dev-token-secret && rm -rf /tmp/flare-core-rn-app-android-bundle && mkdir -p /tmp/flare-core-rn-app-android-bundle && react-native bundle --platform android --entry-file index.js --bundle-output /tmp/flare-core-rn-app-android-bundle/index.android.bundle --assets-dest /tmp/flare-core-rn-app-android-bundle/assets --dev true --reset-cache
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run bundle:ios && npm run bundle:android
